name: STRATUS
recent: Stratus Global 在 2026 年 11 月宣布每股 0.80 仙的首次中期股息，并公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度的业绩。公司近期也出现雇员公积金局（EPF）的股权变动申报，以及主席兼董事 Encik Fazrin Azwar Bin Md. Nor 的多次售股。
notable: 宣布每股 0.80 仙的首次中期股息，除权日为 2026 年 11 月 27 日。
公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度的业绩。
主席兼董事 Encik Fazrin Azwar Bin Md. Nor 在 2026 年 8 月至 10 月间多次出售股份。
risks: 主席兼董事 Encik Fazrin Azwar Bin Md. Nor 在 2026 年 8 月至 10 月间多次出售股份。
EPF 近期多次申报股权变动，包括成为主要股东及不再是大股东。

recent_en: Stratus Global declared a first interim dividend of 0.80 sen per share in November 2026 and announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026. The company also saw EPF shareholding changes and several disposals by Chairman and Director Encik Fazrin Azwar Bin Md. Nor.
notable_en: Declared a first interim dividend of 0.80 sen per share, with ex-date on 27 November 2026.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
Chairman and Director Encik Fazrin Azwar Bin Md. Nor disposed of shares multiple times between August and October 2026.
risks_en: Chairman and Director Encik Fazrin Azwar Bin Md. Nor disposed of shares multiple times between August and October 2026.
EPF recently filed multiple shareholding changes, including becoming a substantial shareholder and ceasing to be one.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM34,844,000 and net income was RM9,548,000, with a net margin of 27.4%.
